sloka: संचोदितो रथः शीघ्रम् खरस्य रिपु घातिनः ।शब्देन आपूरयामास दिशः स प्रदिशः तथा ॥३-२२-२३॥
transliteration: saṁcodito rathaḥ śīghram kharasya ripu ghātinaḥ ।śabdena āpūrayāmāsa diśaḥ sa pradiśaḥ tathā ॥3-22-23॥

translations.english: Khara's chariot moved a bit behind the army of demons of frightening prowess who rushed forward to attack (Rama).
